workflows.description: monotonic process improvement with deterministic and content-skill regression checks.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered reflection_testing_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared reflection_testing_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by reflection_testing_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Assess a Mathformer trajectory, propose one monotone process revision, test it against prior successful cases, and decide adoption.
reasoning_projection.name: RefineMathformerWorkflow

occurrences.rationale: Compare workflow evidence and expose bounded improvement hypotheses.
Create an immutable candidate revision with explicit preservation obligations.
Run deterministic and content probes against the candidate revision and baseline cases.
Adopt, retain experimentally, reject, or block the revision under regression and control constraints.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: one immutable candidate revision and bounded regression comparison
